architecture.component: rust/crates/repopact-confinement plus rust/apps/repopact-sandbox; Python LandlockConfinementProvider plus LandlockSandboxAdapter compose the optional provider/launcher path.
architecture.authority_flow: The host-controlled helper sends the signed request and receipt directly to the protected guard, receives the guard-generated opaque lease token and safe lease metadata, validates identity/capability metadata, compiles the path ceiling, sanitizes descriptors, applies Landlock, revalidates the lease, then execs explicit argv.
architecture.caller_widening: Caller arguments are never an authority source. The helper consumes guard metadata, rejects missing or malformed ceilings, rejects traversal, unsupported globs, symlink components, missing paths, and broad roots containing frozen descendants without approval; representability failures prevent target start.
architecture.peer_binding: The helper is the guard IPC peer and does not accept caller-supplied PID, UID, GID, or session claims. Unix endpoint and parent-chain protection are checked before each IPC call; the opaque peer-bound lease remains in the helper.
architecture.capability_resolution: NativeGuardClient plus PreActionAdapter remains pre-action. sandbox/process-enforced is reported only by the confinement-backed adapter/provider after protected-helper attestation and a passing native probe. Missing, unhealthy, unprotected, non-Linux, or unproven helpers resolve to not-covered and cannot satisfy a required sandbox class.

landlock.minimum_abi_rationale: REFER is required for cross-directory link/rename/reparent semantics and TRUNCATE is required for mutation completeness; the kernel contract therefore requires ABI 3 or newer.
landlock.reads: unrestricted by this initial mutation-confinement ruleset; no confidentiality/read-isolation claim
landlock.no_new_privs: implemented with PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS before landlock_restrict_self; native observation not run
landlock.ruleset_application: implemented with runtime ABI query, ruleset creation, path-beneath rules, restriction, and fail-closed errors; native application not run
landlock.representability: Only existing exact paths and trailing /** directory ceilings are accepted. Paths are canonicalized under the repository root, symlink components and unsupported patterns are rejected, and descendant rules are deduplicated beneath ancestor rules. A broad root containing governance, repopact/schemas, or .github/workflows is rejected without frozen approval.

native_matrix.unrepresentable_policy: Portable Rust test passed for a broad root containing a frozen descendant; the compiler rejects it without approval. Native helper proof not run.
native_matrix.unsupported_host_fail_closed: Portable provider test passed for non-Linux resolution to not-covered; Linux ENOSYS/EOPNOTSUPP/old-ABI/native restriction paths are implemented but not executed here.
native_matrix.inherited_descriptors: The launcher checks descriptors 0/1/2, rejects directory capabilities and unapproved writable files/devices, and closes descriptors above stderr. No pass-fd feature exists. Native adversarial proof not run.
native_matrix.descendant_inheritance: Landlock is applied in the launcher before target creation and inherited by subsequently created descendants; the helper also creates a session/process group and sets PDEATHSIG for supervision. Native child/grandchild proof not run.

lease_lifecycle.expiry: The helper performs an initial guard check after restriction and polls the peer-bound opaque token every 250ms; denial terminates the supervised process group. Native expiry observation not run.
lease_lifecycle.revocation: Operator revocation is evaluated by the protected guard, not Landlock. A failed poll terminates the supervised group while the monotonic Landlock domain remains in force. Native revocation observation not run.
lease_lifecycle.guard_loss: IPC failure fails closed and terminates the supervised group; target is not started if initial authorization/revalidation fails. Native guard-loss observation not run.
lease_lifecycle.detached_descendants: The Landlock domain is inherited by descendants, but process-group termination is best effort for detached descendants; no immediate kill guarantee for already-detached processes is claimed.
